# Ivan Farfan Diaz

> Full-stack Software Engineer and Automation Engineer at One Stone LLC. Senior Software Engineering student at Stevens Institute of Technology. Founder of Vertex, an award-winning 3D modeling startup. VP of Design at Blueprint. Based in Hoboken, NJ.

Last updated: 2026-03-14

## About

Ivan Farfan Diaz is a full-stack software engineer, automation specialist, and 3D modeler based in Hoboken, NJ. He is completing his senior year in Software Engineering at Stevens Institute of Technology. He works as an Automation Engineer at One Stone LLC, building REST API integrations, automated workflows, and custom dashboards for CRM systems.

## Technical Skills

React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Python, Flask, Swift, SwiftUI, Blender, REST APIs, computer vision, machine learning pipelines, CRM automation.

## Projects

- [Vertex](https://vertex3d.site/): Wireframe-to-3D-model pipeline using machine learning to convert hand-drawn sketches into editable 3D geometry. Built with React and Python/Flask. Winner of the Thomas H. Scholl Award (2024) at Stevens Institute of Technology for technical innovation and commercial viability. Part of the Launchpad/iSTEM program since 2022.
- [DishDetective](https://github.com/IvanFarfan08/DishDetective): Point-of-Sale system using Google's Teachable Machine for computer vision-based food recognition. Reduces transaction time and human error in food service environments.
- [Recalled](https://devpost.com/software/hackathon-project-3kxw6c): iOS and visionOS app that scans product barcodes to check against FDA and CPSC recall databases in real time. Built with Swift and Apple's Vision framework.
- [Vertex Annotator](https://www.vertexannotator.xyz/): Web platform for creating labeled wireframe parsing datasets used to train Vertex's machine learning models. Exports annotations in ML-ready formats.

## Leadership

VP of Design at Blueprint, a student-run organization developing free software solutions for non-profit organizations. Leads the design team across multiple NPO projects, conducts design reviews, and mentors junior designers.
